rationale: Create one Oriden renewable-development platform record. I Squared's Energy Transition Infrastructure Fund completed the acquisition of Oriden LLC from Mitsubishi Power Americas on or before April 27, 2026, and I Squared continued to list the company as active. Individual projects and project SPVs remain beneath the platform boundary; the January 2026 Abes Run transaction was a project-level sale and not a sale of Oriden.

afterImage.name: Oriden
afterImage.description: Oriden is a U.S. renewable-energy development platform focused on utility-scale solar and battery storage across MISO, PJM and other eastern U.S. markets. The company covers origination, permitting, interconnection, financing, construction oversight, asset management and operations and maintenance, and disclosed a development pipeline exceeding 5 GW at acquisition. I Squared Capital's Energy Transition Infrastructure Fund completed the acquisition of Oriden LLC from Mitsubishi Power Americas on or before April 27, 2026; the exact stake, vehicle, price and legal closing date were not publicly disclosed. Mitsubishi launched the platform in 2019 and exited in the 2026 sale. Individual projects and project SPVs, including Abes Run, remain beneath the platform boundary, and no later Oriden sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.

ownershipPeriods.stake: Former owner; exact percentage not publicly disclosed

milestones.event: Mitsubishi Hitachi Power Systems Americas publicly launched Oriden as a U.S. renewable-development business.
Oriden announced an agreement to sell the Abes Run solar project; the project-level transaction did not transfer the Oriden platform.
I Squared Capital announced that its Energy Transition Infrastructure Fund had completed the acquisition of Oriden LLC from Mitsubishi Power Americas.
